description: This file defines the OriginatorSubscriber class, which implements an event subscriber for handling email message headers in Drupal, specifically setting default 'from' and 'sender' headers and removing redundant sender headers based on RFC 5322 rules.

classes.name: OriginatorSubscriber
classes.description: A Drupal event subscriber class that manages email headers for outgoing messages, ensuring proper 'from' and 'sender' headers according to RFC standards.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting configuration and language management services.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Handles the message event, setting default headers and removing redundant sender headers.

methods.name: setDefaultFrom
methods.description: Sets the default 'from' address if none is set.

methods.name: setDefaultSender
methods.description: Sets the default 'sender' address if none is set.

methods.name: removeRedundantSender
methods.description: Removes the 'Sender' header if it is redundant based on RFC rules.

methods.name: getSiteAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the site email address based on the current language context.

methods.name: executeInEnvironment
methods.description: Executes a callback within a specific language environment, temporarily overriding the language setting.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this subscriber listens to, specifically the MessageEvent.
